scripts.encode: ffmpeg -y -i out/wmcp-demo.webm -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/wmcp-demo.mp4
scripts.encode:agent: ffmpeg -y -i out/wmcp-agent-demo.webm -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart out/wmcp-agent-demo.mp4
scripts.encode:all: for f in out/wmcp-*.webm; do ffmpeg -y -i "$f" -c:v libx264 -preset slow -crf 22 -pix_fmt yuv420p -movflags +faststart "${f%.webm}.mp4"; done
scripts.all: npm run record && npm run encode
scripts.all:agent: npm run record:agent && npm run encode:agent
scripts.all:all: npm run record:all && npm run encode:all
